subject: Eval kickoff: captains, cadence & handoffs
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@lumenware.com>, Eli Moreno <eli@lumenware.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Eval kickoff: captains, cadence & handoffs

Hi Olivia & Eli —

Thanks again for the chat earlier. Quick recap and a proposed plan to get the eval (4-week POC) running smoothly. Please confirm owners and the procurement timeline so we can lock dates.

High-level success criteria (proposed):
- Functional: Redwood API integrated with LumenWare app, end-to-end inference for 3 representative flows.
- Performance: p95 latency < 250ms, p99 < 350ms under your expected traffic profile (see attachment for test profile).
- Cost/Scaling: sustain 20 req/s with acceptable unit cost; validate autoscaling behavior on Dedicated pool.
- Security/Compliance: SOC2 summary reviewed, basic onboarding controls verified (no customer data at rest for the trial unless sanitized).

Suggested evaluation plan & timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): kickoff, owner confirmations, procurement requests (if any).
- Week 1: infra provisioning + sample integration (basic calls).
- Week 2: functional test sweep + performance baseline.
- Week 3: load test & regression checks.
- Week 4: decision window + retention/next steps.

Ownership (please confirm or correct):
- LumenWare app/integration owner: Eli Moreno (account side)
- LumenWare procurement/legal: Olivia Barnes / procurement@lumenware.com
- Redwood infra & provisioning: Aditya Rao (SE)
- Redwood security/compliance owner: Monica Patel
- Deal lead / commercial contact: Marissa Cole

Cadence: 30-minute weekly syncs (propose Tuesdays 10:00am PST), with a short triage channel in Slack for blockers.

Attachments: redwood-poc-handoff-guide.pdf (provisioning checklist & test matrix).

Can you reply with confirmed owners, any procurement constraints (PO, SSO, data policy signoff), and whether the proposed cadence works?

Thanks —
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com


From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@lumenware.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Eli Moreno <eli@lumenware.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Eval kickoff: captains, cadence & handoffs

Thanks Sean — this is helpful. Confirming owners and constraints from LumenWare: 

Owners (LumenWare):
- App/Integration lead: Eli Moreno (Platform Lead) — will own schema mapping and dev work.
- Test data / privacy owner: me (Olivia) — we need guidance on data sanitization; we prefer to use synthetic sets if possible.
- Procurement: procurement@lumenware.com (cc'd in the thread) — typical timeline for a standard MSA + PO is ~2 weeks, but we may need an expedited path.

Constraints and asks:
- Please share your SOC2 summary and a short list of what infra access is needed. We cannot share production data; we will provide a sanitized subset.
- Legal needs a short addendum outlining data handling for the trial.
- The cadence looks fine — Tuesdays 10am PST would work for Eli and me starting Jan 19.

I'll attach our internal evaluation checklist for transparency (lumenware-eval-checklist.xlsx). We'll review the success criteria internally and revert with any changes by EOD Monday.

Olivia
Olivia Barnes
Head of Platform Ops, LumenWare
olivia@lumenware.com

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@lumenware.com>, Eli Moreno <eli@lumenware.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Eval kickoff: captains, cadence & handoffs

Hi all —

Thanks for the quick replies and the checklist, Olivia. A few clarifications from Redwood security & infra: 

1) SOC2 & compliance artifacts
- Attached: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (high-level summary). I can pull the SOC2 bridging notes for legal if they need more detail.

2) Infra ownership and provisioning
- Redwood will provision a dedicated evaluation environment (isolated tenant in our hosted fleet or a Dedicated trial node depending on your preference). Aditya will lead provisioning steps and will need a list of allowed IPs / service endpoints.

3) Proposed RACI (please confirm):
- Responsible (R): Redwood SE (Aditya Rao) — infra setup, test harness, baseline run.
- Accountable (A): LumenWare App lead (Eli Moreno) — app integration, acceptance of functional tests.
- Consulted (C): Redwood Security (Monica Patel) & LumenWare Platform (Olivia Barnes) — review of data handling, security signoffs.
- Informed (I): Deal lead (Marissa Cole) & Procurement.

4) Success metric thresholds we recommend including in the plan:
- p95 latency under test profile: < 250ms
- p99 latency under test profile: < 350ms
- Throughput validated at 20 requests/sec with <5% error rate
- End-to-end functional pass for the 3 canonical flows in the checklist

5) Next steps before kickoff (action owners):
- LumenWare: confirm procurement timeline and provide sanitized sample data (Olivia) — due Mon 2027-01-18 EOD.
- LumenWare: confirm app owner contact (Eli) and provide IP allowlist if using on-prem ingress.
- Redwood: Aditya to send provisioning playbook and a small test harness by EOD Jan 18.
- Redwood: Sean/Marissa to send calendar invites for weekly cadence starting Jan 19.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf

I'll be on the Tuesday standups for security signoff.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Manager, Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>

Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Eval kickoff: captains, cadence & handoffs

Got it — I'll be the SE point for provisioning and tests.

Immediate nexts from my side:
- Sending provisioning playbook + minimal test harness (attached) so your devs can run local smoke tests.
- I'll request an allowlist and the sanitized sample payloads. If you prefer synthetic data, we have a small generator script that mirrors realistic token lengths.
- I'll post a short checklist in the kickoff invite: infra steps, integration endpoints, sample curl commands, and a JMeter script for load tests.

Confirming weekly Tuesday 10:00am PST start on 2027-01-19 — I'll send the calendar invite with the link and a short agenda (15m status + 10m blockers + 5m action items).

Attachments: redwood-poc-handoff-guide.pdf, provisioning-playbook.zip

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
